raw_sections.summary:
Executive Summary
Customer-facing Network Consulting Engineer with 4 years of experience designing, troubleshooting, and automating enterprise networks. Expertise in SD-WAN, Routing and Switching, Python automation, REST APIs, and Technical consulting.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
Cisco	Bangalore, India
Consulting Engineer	Nov 2023 - Present
Delivered network modernization and optimization projects for enterprise customers including Boeing, Standard Chartered, Cox Communications, and Vocus, optimizing 500+ network assets to improve network resilience, performance, and operational efficiency.
Developed Python and Netmiko-based automation solutions to collect device inventory data, streamline asset management, enforce configuration compliance, and automate audit reporting through REST API integrations, reducing manual operational effort by 40%.
Validated 20+ software releases for Cisco ASR9K, NCS, Catalyst, and Nexus platforms in lab environments and led network modernization initiatives involving BGP, QoS, high-availability, and hardware migration projects, reducing deployment risk and accelerating upgrade readiness across enterprise environments.
Leveraged syslog data and custom Splunk dashboards to improve incident response times by 75%, enhancing network visibility and operational efficiency.
Cisco	Bangalore, India
Technical Consulting Engineer	Oct 2022 - Nov 2023
Implemented Cisco SD-WAN solutions for enterprise customers by creating and deploying vManage device templates from ServiceNow and Jira requirements, streamlining onboarding and supporting deployment of 100+ branch sites.
Provided 24x7 operational support and proactive monitoring for Cisco Meraki environments supporting enterprise customers including Vodafone and Wells Fargo, leveraging dashboard analytics, alerts, and network diagnostics across 200+ network assets to improve service reliability and accelerate incident resolution.
Trained and mentored 10+ engineers and apprentices, led technical review panels, and championed knowledge-sharing programs to improve team productivity, technical proficiency, and service quality.
Delivered Python-driven network automation solutions for enterprise customers, integrating Cisco SD-WAN APIs to automate device validation, compliance checks, and health monitoring across distributed WAN environments.
